name: Tennouji Ayaka
source:
Birthplace: Osaka
Special skills: Singing & sports
Hobbies: Doing her nails, watching pro wrestling
Favorite food: Snacks made with Rito

Member of Kanto's project 47's "Team Smile" who is ranked 6th between all of the project 47's idols. Having participated in the previous D.o.D and managing to secure the 2nd place, Ayaka is knowledgeable of the competition to some degree. Ayaka is a very hotblooded idol with a passion for justice and has a confident personality. She often clashes together with [url=/c51180]Chiharu[/url] and considers her her greatest rival, and is almost always shown together with her best friend [url=/c53936]Rito[/url]. However, Ayaka is quite emotional and cries easily as well; despite often taking the initiative and acting like a leader, she is much more shier and sensitive in private.
